 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA  Date : 22/04/2018

ORAL ORDER 1. This Appeal is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat.
2.
Mr. Hardik Soni, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has appeared on behalf of the State and has produced withdrawal / settlement pursis, which is taken on record.
The withdrawal / settlement pursis is signed by the respondent no.2 as well as on behalf of the respondent no.2 in connection with the authorization letter.

3. It is submitted that the offence alleged against the accused under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, is not serious in nature, the penalty / punishment prescribed for such offence is not substantial in view of the Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and R/CR.A/912/2015 ORDER Standard Act, 2006.

entities.text: Food Safety and R/CR.A/912/2015 ORDER Standard Act, 2006
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
4. Today, in the Lok Adalat, the respondent no.1-Purohit Govindsing Davising is present before the State Of Gujarat vs Purohit Govindsing Davising on 22 April, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149009356/
1 court and stated that respondent no.2 is authorizing him to remain present on his behalf before the Court to settle the matter as due to illness, respondent no.2 is not in a position to remain present before the Court.

entities.text: State Of Gujarat vs Purohit Govindsing Davising
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is further submitted that whatever fine will be imposed or decision would be taken by the Court, the respondent no.2 would be abide by the order passed by this Court and he would comply with the order, he himself and on behalf of the respondent no.2.
This authorization letter written by the respondent no.2 dated 21.04.2018 in a stamp paper of Rs. 20/- is produced before the Court in original, which is taken on record.
4. In view of the withdrawal / compromise pursis of the parties, this Appeal stands disposed of.

The respondent Nos. 1 and 2 are directed to pay a sum of Rs.3,000/- (Rupees Five Thousand Only) each (in all, the respondents No.1 and 2 to deposit Rs. 6,000/-) towards litigation cost; as agreed between the parties, in lieu thereof.
Necessary cost be deposited in the office of the High Court Legal Services Committee within four weeks, failing which the Appeal shall stand revived automatically.
Accordingly, this appeal stands disposed of.
R/CR.A/912/2015 ORDER 5.

However, disposal of this matter will not affect any connected matters arising out of the same,
incidental or any other proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other Court.
It is also required to be noted that this order will not be treated as a precedent in any future case for reference.
